notes: Both papers report the indirect effect and bias-corrected 95% confidence interval, without an exact p-value or p bound for that same indirect effect. No p inferred from the intervals. Original CI [1.64, 7.35]; replication CI [1.25, 5.8]. The requested b (unstd) is retained as the printed indirect effect metric without conversion. The author verdict concerns the mediation analyses in Tables 1 and 2 collectively, and explicitly questions their evidential strength as a possible statistical artifact. Replication H6 is on PDF p. 6, not supplied locator p. 5 (which contains full-sample H3).
